name: dls-web
description: Web port of Sebastian Lague's Digital Logic Sim (TypeScript + WebGL2, no game engine)

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path rust/dls-sim/Cargo.toml --profile wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp rust/dls-sim/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/dls_sim.wasm src/worker/dls_sim.wasm
